38:1.text: [These letters (Sâd etc.) are one of the miracles of the Quran and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]
. By the Quran full of reminding.

38:2.text: Nay, those who disbelieve are in false pride and opposition.

38:3.text: How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape.

38:4.text: has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This

38:5.text: . Verily, this is a curious thing!"

38:6.text: And the leaders among them went about
: "Go on, and remain constant to your âlihah
! Verily, this is a thing designed

38:7.text: of this in the religion of these later days
. This is nothing but an invention!

38:8.text: "Has the Reminder been sent down to him
from among us?" Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder
! Nay, but they have not tasted

38:9.text: Or have they the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Real Bestower?

38:10.text: Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? If so, let them ascend up with means

38:11.text: they will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times

38:12.text: (with which he used to punish the people)

38:13.text: And Thamûd, and the people of Lût
, and the Dwellers of the Wood: such were the Confederates.

38:14.text: Not one of them but belied the Messengers; therefore My Torment was justified,

38:15.text: And these only wait for a single Saihah
[shout (i.e. the blowing of the Trumpet by the angel Isrâfil -)]
there will be no pause or ending thereto
[till everything will perish except Allâh (the only God full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour)]

38:16.text: They say: "Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittanâ
(i.e. our Record of good and bad deeds so that we may see it)
